rule_text: Initiative establishes the order of turns in combat and that order repeats each round unless a rule explicitly changes it.

heading: Turns in Combat
content: A turn is the active window for one combatant in initiative order. When that turn ends, control passes to the next combatant.

title: Attack Roll Sequence
text: Attack rolls determine hit or miss before any damage is rolled. Compare the d20 plus attack bonus against Armor Class.

name: Damage Step
desc: Damage is rolled only after a hit or successful effect, then applied to current hit points without changing whether the attack hit.

body: Current hit points change during play. Maximum hit points are the ceiling and usually do not change when ordinary damage is applied.

heading: Basic Actions in Combat
content: In the MVP engine, supported mechanical combat actions are attack, move, and end turn. Other actions must fail honestly as unsupported.
